$comment: Hash of each frozen version's slice in the dump it was blessed from, excluding doc/description/examples (none of which reach the generated output), taken off the parsed dump before generation runs (see lib/dump-digest.mts). Generation fails if a frozen version's slice moves, because its files are skipped and the rest of the tree would be generated against a model they no longer hold. Run `yarn generate:api` and paste what it prints to seed a version. Record $source when you do.
$source: ghcr.io/truenas/middleware:master, middlewared 20261004040744~truenas+1 (digest sha256:93ea22a7fafe5c027bc2768c406a1755d69d9f9f765dd4f3ee9d7a6ed0f98fdb, fetched 2026-10-05). Everything the 2026-10-01 seed recorded still holds and is not repeated here; what follows is what moved. **The headline is not a drift at all: middleware renumbered its two newest versions.** d3b89cea4d ('Bump version names: 26.0.0 -> 27.0.0, 27.0.0 -> 28.0.0') renamed what this tree carried as v26.0.0 to v27.0.0 and what it carried as v27.0.0 to v28.0.0, 26 having never left prerelease. Confirmed by surface rather than by number: the old v26.0.0 and the new v27.0.0 declare identical 831-method sets, and the new v28.0.0 carries all 842 of the old v27.0.0's plus eleven new zfs.resource.* calls. The dump reports eight slices and v26.0.0 is not among them, so hand-removed.json's key moves to v27.0.0 -- the release that dropped virt.* and pool.dataset.encryption_algorithm_choices is the same one under its new name, and the removal did not move a version later. **The frozen files again do not move with the hashes, and this time nothing that moved could have reached them.** Three things differ in substance from the 2026-10-01 dump across all six 25.10 slices. The first is the only one on the call side: zfs.resource.query's removed_in goes from null to "v28". That field is threaded to MethodModel.removedIn and never read, so no emitted type can carry it; its own shape is untouched. The second is a new zfs.resource.list event, and the third is a role rename on the zfs.tier.rewrite_job_query and zfs.tier.rewrite_job_status events, DATASET_READ -> ZFS_RESOURCE_READ. Both are the unfiltered-event leak: v25.10.0 declares no zfs.tier method at all, and the role rename could not reach TypeScript even where the method is real, because roles are threaded like removed_in and the only roles in the output are `roles: string[]` fields on privilege models, never the values. So the usual question -- would regenerating delete a shape a 25.10 appliance really sends -- does not even arise here; there is no candidate. Only the hashes follow the dump. **Expect these six to move again for a reason that is not drift either.** The renumber did not update removed_in: six methods on master still declare removed_in="v26", a version middleware's own dump no longer lists, and d3b89cea4d changed none of those lines. aervin is fixing that upstream. removed_in reaches no generated type, but dumpDigest strips only doc, description and examples, so it is inside these digests and his change will drift all six.
